summary_pt: Jogo local com presença e chat LAN opcionais: equipamentos, atributos, habilidades suportadas, economia e missões ampliados; o servidor original não foi reconstruído.

lan_network.scope: Presence, GEAR poses and plain-text chat only; combat, missions, inventory and rewards stay individual.

content.complete_definition: Available native terrain or native non-tile world composition, eligible collision/flags, original props and linked daytime sky/clouds without recorded static-resource gaps; not complete MMO gameplay.
content.mission_availability: Semantic support is not playability: map/actor availability and native level, faction, gear and prerequisite requirements still gate execution.

implemented.physics: Selected native engine ITEMs and ported flight, boost/heat, brake, lateral thrust, inclination correction, landing and A-GEAR ground/siege branches. Advanced original state equivalence is unverified.
implemented.world: Original terrain/flags, pooled scenery, native portal destinations and DAT event/NPC positions when available. Partial and unavailable resources remain explicit in the browser.
implemented.missions: Bounded allowlist compiler for recovered scripts, original requirement gates, kill/dialogue/navigation objectives and idempotent rewards; unsupported clauses fail closed.
implemented.combat: Local PvE with native ITEM damage, cadence, ammo, heat, range and source formulas; native MEX identities/HP and selected Belligerence behaviors. World occlusion applies to weapons and visibility.
implemented.inventory: Owned local items and original icons; validated weapons, engine, armor, CPU, radar and supported accessories with native requirements and selected source modifiers. Catalog browsing does not grant ownership.
implemented.equipment: Source stat increments and caps, explicit bonus-point allocation, native armor/CPU/radar fields and fail-closed unsupported parameters. Equipped armor selects its recovered visual; cosmetic previews remain separate.
implemented.skills: Explicit paid learning, class/level/prerequisite gates, eight shortcuts, SP, cooldowns, supported self effects and combat modifiers. Unsupported targets and unported parameters remain blocked.
implemented.economy: Local shop stock with native ITEM prices/bundles and source sale percentage; conservative native mixing recipes with ingredient/SPI cost, success chance and persisted RNG. HP/DP/EP/SP and ammunition services use source cost rules. Stock, zero tax and city/contact access are explicit local policy.
implemented.network: Optional LAN host/join/disconnect and plain-text chat, up to eight participants. Remote GEAR presence only; no shared combat, authority, mission rewards, trade or original server emulation.
implemented.progression: Pinned native experience thresholds through level125 and source level-up limits; earned XP ledger, effective XP and discarded excess stay distinct. Native 2025 server progression is unverified.
implemented.appearance: Class-compatible native armor models can be tested visually from M without granting armor or changing combat/engine statistics. Default appearance can be restored.
implemented.audio: Original audio registry and map BGM bindings; music toggle in M. Importing sounds does not mean every original audio event is implemented.
implemented.camera: Local chase camera avoids eligible Collision1 world geometry; other props and original camera behavior are not claimed.
implemented.water: Static original water patches use native map metadata and water/black texture pixels with preserved alpha; complete original DirectX distortion/reflection shader is not ported.
implemented.ui: Original blue HUD and inventory artwork plus bounded searchable catalogs for missions/maps/items/appearances/services/skills, validated attribute controls and optional LAN connection. HP/DP/SP/ammo and eight skill shortcuts bind to actual local models.

native_quest_102.runtime_return_policy: Resolve9999 by faction: influence2->2001,4->2002; local normal profile uses configured start city2001. Fallback to acceptance map is explicit only if required city resources are unavailable.

adaptations: Fixed120Hz clock, keyboard/mouse control, radius4 contact body, continuous sweep, safe spawn, portal cooldown and instantaneous landing/takeoff bridges.
Initial level9 profile, local starter reserve, encounter positions, scheduling, movement/attack fallbacks and respawn; no server spawn database was supplied.
Initial local training enables compatible supported rank1 skills separately from native account ownership; subsequent learning is explicit and charged through the local school service.
Native NPC position/name/greeting when DAT event9 is present; nearby NPC3 fallback position and interaction markers/range are explicit local policy.
Quick map travel and armor appearance testing are exploration tools, not original routes or ownership.
Local missile pursuit, hit volumes, reproducible RNG, modern lighting/materials and static model poses.
3002 training quest and rings are new local content, separated from recovered missions.
not_implemented: Original MMO server, authentication, accounts and shared multiplayer combat/economy/missions. Optional LAN only shares presence and chat.
Maps marked unavailable, incomplete scenery gaps, every recovered mission clause and all special/group/skill interactions.
Original spawn database, complete per-monster server attributes, native AI scheduler, mesh animations, Cinema missile paths and all original effects/shaders.

Hyperbooster, complete flight state machine, every skill/enchant/formation modifier and complete takeoff/landing patterns. Fuel-depletion trigger/consumption is ported; falling movement is a local ballistic bridge.
All original equipment/skill effects, instance enchantment, official shop stock/taxes and stateful crafting targets beyond the supported local subset.
Complete original water distortion/reflection shader, weather/day-night renderer and proven visual or functional equivalence against the original client.
